detail.longDescription:
Learn Anything, Anywhere, Anytime With Alison’s Free Online Courses.

Alison is a free online learning app for education, career development, and job-ready skills. Join 50+ million learners across 195+ countries using Alison to learn online and earn globally recognised, CPD-accredited diplomas and certificates with 6,000+ courses across business, AI, tech, health, management, marketing, data science, and more.

Learn Skills for Careers, Business or Personal Development:
Whether you want to upskill, reskill, switch careers, grow a side hustle, or unlock new goals, Alison helps you build in-demand skills with online education. It allows you to tailor your learning based on your needs and interests, build job-ready skills for in-demand roles, and keep current with industry-relevant knowledge and developments. You can even showcase accredited Certificates and Diplomas on your resumé.


WHY CHOOSE THE ALISON LEARNING APP?
Free access to 6,000+ online courses
Flexible self-paced learning at your own convenience
Learn online with mobile-first course content
Personalised course recommendations to fit your needs
Schedule study reminders and track your progress
Synced coursework progress across all your devices
Flexible access for online education anytime
Course content suitable for use in areas with low internet connectivity

POPULAR IN-DEMAND SUBJECTS:
Data Analysis Fundamentals: Learn statistics basics and job-ready data analysis skills.
Data Science Essentials:  Build skills for data analyst, data scientist, and data engineer paths.
Machine Learning Foundations: Understand AI, models and applied machine learning concepts.
Cybersecurity Basics: Learn security fundamentals for cybersecurity analyst career tracks.
IT Support Specialist Training: Learn troubleshooting, systems, and IT support skills.
Front End Developer Skills:  Learn HTML, CSS, and coding skills to build web projects.
Back-End Developer Skills: Learn development concepts, databases, and server fundamentals.
DevOps Engineer Basics: Learn operations, automation, and deployment workflows.
Project Manager Essentials: Develop project management skills.
Business Strategy Fundamentals: Learn business strategy and management decision-making.
Digital Marketing and Social Media Marketing: Learn marketing, ads, and growth skills.
Sales and Customer Support Skills: Build communication skills for business and sales roles.
Entrepreneurship Essentials: Learn how to launch, validate, and grow your business idea.
Health and Care Support: Learn health fundamentals for support-focused career paths.
UX Design Fundamentals: Learn UX design / design thinking and product development basics.

WHY WAIT? DOWNLOAD THE ALISON LEARNING APP TO EMPOWER YOURSELF TODAY!

Alison helps you learn skills, earn certificates, and advance your career with free online education developed by industry experts - all at your own pace. Download the Alison courses app to study, build skills, and achieve your goals.
